# cloud-day-trader-skill

> Official architecture documentation and production specifications for cloud-day-trader-skill

## Documentation

- [Home](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/cloud-day-trader-skill/index.html)
- [Documentation Catalog](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/cloud-day-trader-skill/docs/index.html)
- [cloud-day-trader-skill 分布式架构设计与拓扑调度规约](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/cloud-day-trader-skill/docs/architecture.html): 1. 去中心化弹性伸缩：支持大规模节点并发接入与轻量化状态同步。
- [cloud-day-trader-skill 核心通信协议与数据同步技术规范](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/cloud-day-trader-skill/docs/specifications.html): - 传输层默认启用 TLS 1.3 协议通道与 AES-256 加密。
- [cloud-day-trader-skill 架构升级与技术规约 (v1)](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/cloud-day-trader-skill/docs/specs-update-v1.html): 针对大规模网络请求调度，系统实施了毫秒级负载感知与去中心化可信存活探测。
- [cloud-day-trader-skill 全息索引网络与搜索引擎感知接入指南](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/cloud-day-trader-skill/docs/topology-guide.html): 1. 配置本地环境并完成节点注册。
